tasks.label: Android ▶ Build + Run + Logcat (Studio-like)
tasks.command: echo '▶ Building & installing...'; ./gradlew installDebug; echo '▶ Launching app...'; adb shell am start -n com.nil.mopitube/.MainActivity; echo '▶ Waiting for app PID...'; until PID=$(adb shell pidof -s com.nil.mopitube); do sleep 0.5; done; echo "▶ PID=$PID"; adb logcat --pid=$PID
